نفترش (form VIII)
# نَفْتَرِشُ (naftarišu) /naf.ta.ri.ʃu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِفْتَرَشَ (iftaraša)
# نُفْتَرَشُ (nuftarašu) /nuf.ta.ra.ʃu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَرَشَ (iftaraša)
# نَفْتَرِشَ (naftariša) /naf.ta.ri.ʃa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِفْتَرَشَ (iftaraša)
# نُفْتَرَشَ (nuftaraša) /nuf.ta.ra.ʃa/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
